name: The Hurtful Wall
source:
The story is about a 17-year-old girl named Lois who realizes how solitary her life is.

Her foster mother, Rebecca, is always busy working out of town, so Lois had to learn how to take care of herself.

One day, after another unsuccessful encounter with Rebecca, Lois heard a scream and saw things that were out of the ordinary.

She thinks that her solitude has affected her mind... But all of her fears will grow when one wall of her house speaks to her, addressing itself as “Canaan”.

[Adopted from Lemma Soft]
translation:
故事讲述了一位名叫洛伊丝的十七岁女孩，她逐渐意识到自己的生活有多么孤独。

她的养母丽贝卡总是忙于在外地工作，因此洛伊丝不得不学会照顾自己。

某天，又一次与丽贝卡交流未果之后，洛伊丝听到了一声尖叫，还看见了一些异乎寻常的事物。

她觉得，是孤独影响了自己的心智…然而，当家中的一面墙开口对她说话，并自称“迦南”时，她所有的恐惧都将愈演愈烈。

[改编自Lemma Soft]
